blurb: Guests enjoy 2-hour small group semi-private wine tasting tours on Lake Tahoe aboard the Golden Rose boat. Tours include tasting 8 wines from Northern California regions while cruising Emerald Bay and viewing Vikingsholm castle and Fannette Island. Operating May through October with up to 4 cruises daily.
extraNote: Operating season May through October · Guests can bring their own snacks or purchase grab-and-go items at Pirate's Chest Tahoe · Tahoe Keys Marina, South Lake Tahoe, California · May through October
